title: The Sealed Hoard
pages:
The fleet paid in gold and the captain paid it into a room with one door.

When the water came in he stayed with the hoard, and sealed the door from the inside. Not against the sea. Against his own crew.

The crew still walks the flooded halls, and so does he. The gold was never the cargo. It was the anchor.

I counted the strongboxes I could not open, and I left them for him. He earned them.
